topics.title: I. Golden
topics.short: A gentle, singing piece in 3/4 and G major built on the golden ratio: 89 bars of 8-bar and 5-bar sections in Fibonacci order.

topics.title: II. Silver
topics.short: A slow, singing Adagio in D major built on √2 − 1, whose continued fraction is all 2s: 12-bar sections with a 5-bar B section after every second one.

topics.title: III. The Fifth
topics.short: A lively Allegretto in F major built on the musical fifth, log₂(3/2): 53 bars, because 53 is the next stop after 12 on the ladder of fifths.

topics.title: IV. Euler
topics.short: A waltz in A minor built on e − 2, whose continued fraction grows 2, 4, 6, 8: 7-bar sections, a short 4-bar B, and a form that keeps stretching.

topics.title: V. Pi
topics.short: A Moderato in C major built on π − 3: fifteen 7-bar phrases, one held bar and one more phrase, 113 bars in all, the 113 of the famous fraction 355/113.

topics.title: VI. Pi, bar 32,996
topics.short: Fifty bars from deep inside pi’s full form: the end of the 292nd 113-bar cycle and the start of the first short cycle, the rare block that comes about 23 hours in.
